title: Juicy Silky Argentinian Duck Wrap
description: A peppery and silky weeknight Argentinian dish featuring duck fat, leaf-wrap-steam, and flexitarian-friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a ti-leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the duck breast with red pepper flakes and salt.
Heat the duck fat in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast until browned on both sides, then set aside.
Add the sliced red onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Wrap the duck breast in ti leaves, then place in a steamer basket.
Steam the duck breast for 10 minutes, or until cooked to 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the duck breast and serve with caramelized onions, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
